background:
Robb was an engineer on Apple's SwiftUI team, where he contributed to the
framework and presented "Create custom visual effects with SwiftUI" at WWDC 2024.
Before that, he was on the UIKit team at Apple, where he helped ship Drag and
Drop on iPad for iOS 11.
He co-founded Moving Parts (YC S21) and created Pow, an open-source library of
SwiftUI transitions. He also worked at Google Research on rapid prototyping and
at SoundCloud as an early iOS engineer.

known_for:
- Engineer on Apple's SwiftUI framework team

- Shipping Drag and Drop on iPad for iOS 11 (US Patent 10444976B2)
- SwiftUI Snippets Patreon with advanced animation tutorials

notable_content:
- Patreon posts on Metal shaders in SwiftUI
